note: RO-3a: the body plans every Billie is built on (body-plan-animation.js animates them) and the placeholder Billies baked from them by game/js/logic/placeholder-art.js (npm run bake:placeholders). plans: per plan the animation numbers (q) and its bones, each with its parent, its middle in the stage box at rest (c: x, y from the middle of the ground line, y up is negative), its size, its pivot (pv: the joint, as fractions of its box), the shape and tone the placeholder paints, the draw order from the front (z) and from behind (zb), its part slot (rules.json parts.slots; null: none), also (RO-3c: a second slot the same bone answers to where the plan has no bone of its own for it: the octopus's mantle is its body and its head, the blob's body its head; the bone takes its slot's size and is never grafted), a turn at rest (rr, radians), and face (the head with its eyes and blink), squash (the squash and stretch frames), lag (drawn a tick late). A bone with mirror copies another (its middle, pivot and turn mirrored, its picture flipped) with its own fields on top; a bone with size null has no picture. sheet: the drawing sheets (a cell per picture on a magenta ground, a label strip above, pivot ticks on the cell edge). paint: the placeholder look. forms: the placeholder Billies (RO-3b).
